title: Temperature Controlled PCR Prep With Tube Strips
author: Opentrons
materials: Mastermix is distributed to the plate (same tip).

steps.title: Configure OT-2 parameters
steps.instruction: Set the OT-2 robot parameters: Number of columns (samples, divisible by 8, range 1‑96); Delay after aspiration (seconds); Mix repetitions (times); Tube aspiration height (mm); Tube‑strip aspiration height for multi‑channel (mm); Aspiration/dispense rate (relative, e.g., 1 = default speed, 0.5 = half speed); P20 Multi GEN2 mount (left or right); P20 Single GEN2 mount (left or right).

steps.title: Distribute mastermix to plate
steps.instruction: Using the OT-2, dispense reliance One Step Multiplex RT‑qPCR supermix into each well of a 96‑well plate kept on ice at 4 °C, employing the same tip for all wells (or per column as configured).

steps.title: Add saliva and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer saliva samples from custom Opentrons tube racks to the corresponding wells containing mastermix, using a new tip for each transfer, then mix the combined contents the specified number of repetitions at the defined aspiration/dispense rate and aspiration heights.
